title: E-FRC-0194: emission on the husk runs backward: a stand-in emitter coupled to the exactly linear husk leapfrog...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0194 in the gauge arena: emission on the husk runs backward: a stand-in emitter coupled to the exactly linear husk leapfrog radiates its excitation away in 150 beats, and 150 beats run backward gather the light back and re-excite it to rounding, with Gauss law exact both ways and a small change at the turn carried rather than amplified.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
